Tanker strikes, US strikes on Iran and a softer word from Trump: what markets carry into Monday and a CPI week

Why it matters: In this war, higher oil has tended to mean higher inflation, more Fed hikes and a weaker gold price, so the headlines do not translate into a simple safe-haven rally.

Context: The counterweight came later on Sunday. Trump told CNN that renewed attacks on Iran were "highly unlikely" if talks make progress.

Read the full brief: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/tanker-strikes-us-strikes-on-iran

Capital Chronicle's dated review provides analysis, not independently confirmed event facts or a performance record.

Base case: 55% Capital Chronicle model estimate. Talks continue; oil firms at the open, then fades.
Alternative: 25% Capital Chronicle model estimate. Hormuz escalation lifts oil and weighs on stocks.
